timeline.tweet: Oh dear, I will be finishing time limited therapy in the New Year and will be having to pay for therapy privately after that.

I'm having to pay for private therapy for DID. When I was in the system I saw a phsychotherapist for time limited therapy. Before I finished I was told that the NHS remit was on stabising patients. Not much good for people who have been through trauma before the age of 6.
Thank you for this. I have just attended my PIP assessment. Feeling emotionally and physically exhausted so am having to go back to sleep. Thinking of everyone who is struggling today.

Have you had the experience of being sexually abused for years, beaten and emotionally abused? I have, and the scars are held in the body as body memories. There are intrusive flashbacks and you dissociate regularly......
I'm going to appeal but honestly I shouldn't have to. There is enough evidence to support my claim.
I was awarded eventually when we applied for an appeal and they realised they didn't have a leg to stand on if it went to appeal. It's a cruel and brutal system.

We had a further split at the age of 28 when we had our first child. A couple of us adult host parts are protectors. It wasn't obvious until we started to get to know our system. There was no knowledge of having a dissociative disorder let alone DID. We were 48 when diagnosed!!
Awww this looks like Nutmeg who sadly passed away yesterday, he was very old but I'm sure would be sitting on this throne.
There are loads of protests in the U.K. against Trump, I know I live in England and he's not welcome here. Trump has obviously got a blindfold on and earplugs in and is using fake news as denial.

Honesty, caring & the most important thing is communication. Accepting that you both will change as the decades move on & that is ok, accepting those changes is key. I've been married for nearly 30 years, we have both changed but still love each other.

Well said, I'm currently in the shielding group & my daughter has just moved out so for the first time in 23 years we are without children at home yet I'm coping. Having been through prolonged trauma makes people stronger. 1.
